subject.title: fix(ui): Realtime Talk hangs when Google Live connections stall

question: Should Google Live Realtime Talk preserve the existing WebRTC-style 30-second startup cutoff through provider `setupComplete`, accepting that unusually slow legitimate startup attempts will now be terminated and cleaned up?
rationale: The timeout is a deliberate user-visible availability policy, not a mechanical correctness choice; source and proof support its cleanup behavior but cannot decide the product tolerance for slow starts.

options.title: Accept the 30-second cutoff
options.body: Merge after exact-head checks pass, treating timely failure and resource release as preferable to an indefinitely connecting session.

options.title: Choose a different startup policy
options.body: Request a revised timeout or an explicit retry/product behavior before merge if 30 seconds is too aggressive for supported Google Live environments.

recommendation.title: Accept the 30-second cutoff
recommendation.body: Merge after exact-head checks pass, treating timely failure and resource release as preferable to an indefinitely connecting session.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the current implementation and can provide the implementation context, although broader product ownership remains low-confidence from the available evidence.
